# PidgeIoT

> Open-source IoT device management platform: provision devices, push
> configuration through device shadows, collect telemetry with queryable
> history, receive email alerts, and update firmware over the air. Built in
> Rust end to end: the backend runs on Cloudflare Workers + Durable
> Objects, the dashboard is a WASM single-page app. AGPL-3.0 licensed,
> developed in the open, free during early access.

Devices authenticate with per-device Ed25519 keypairs and compact binary
bearer tokens (not JWTs); refreshing a token cryptographically revokes the
previous one. Supported device transports today: HTTPS, WebSocket, and
CoAP on port 5684, both CoAP-over-DTLS/UDP (the primary transport for
constrained cellular devices) and RFC 8323 CoAP-over-TLS/TCP, each
authenticated by a per-device TLS-PSK, and MQTT 5 or 3.1.1 over TLS on
port 8883, authenticated either by a certificate handshake with the device
token as the CONNECT password or by a per-device TLS-PSK. There is no
cleartext listener on any transport. The device library targets Zephyr
RTOS (vendor-agnostic), with samples for ESP32-C6, Nordic nRF9160/nRF9151,
and a native_sim target that runs the whole platform flow on a desktop
with no hardware.

## Docs

- [Getting Started](https://pidgeiot.com/getting-started/): zero-to-telemetry
  in about ten minutes with a simulated device, no hardware required
- [Documentation](https://pidgeiot.com/documentation/): concepts, namely flocks,
  pigeons, tokens, shadows, telemetry, alerts, OTA firmware
- [API Reference](https://pidgeiot.com/api-reference/): the full HTTP
  surface: dashboard routes, device routes, auth models, WebSocket frames
  (markdown variant: https://pidgeiot.com/api-reference/index.md)
- [Architecture](https://pidgeiot.com/architecture/): how the platform is
  built, edge to database

## Try it

- [Live Demo](https://pidgeiot.com/demo/): real device telemetry, no signup
- [Features](https://pidgeiot.com/features/) and
  [Pricing](https://pidgeiot.com/pricing/): free during early access
- [Compare](https://pidgeiot.com/compare/): every IoT platform price we could
  verify, per device per month at three fleet sizes, each with its source
  and the date we checked it
- [Self-hosting costs](https://pidgeiot.com/self-hosting/): what running
  free software on your own server costs once the licence, the box, and
  the hours on call are counted

## For agents

- [auth.md](https://pidgeiot.com/auth.md): how an agent authenticates,
  covering Kratos account flows, session cookies, device bearer tokens
- [API catalog](https://api.pidgeiot.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727
  linkset for the API host (also mirrored at
  https://pidgeiot.com/.well-known/api-catalog)

## Source

- [pidgeiot](https://github.com/justins-engineering/pidgeiot): the platform
  itself, backend, dashboard, shared wire types (AGPL-3.0)
- [pigeon](https://github.com/justins-engineering/pigeon): Zephyr device
  library (AGPL-3.0)
- [pigeon-examples](https://github.com/justins-engineering/pigeon-examples):
  device samples incl. the no-hardware native_sim variants (AGPL-3.0)
